summary: State-dependent vtable dispatch for a UI widget. Reads a mode (0-4) from ShortComputation_6720(this) and, per mode, maps boolean input a2 to a specific argument for a virtual method at offset 64. Cases 0 and 1 invoke the method only when a2 is set; cases 2 and 3 only when a2 is clear; case 4 gates the dispatch on the current state byte from ByteFieldGetterAt100 and selects the argument (2 or 0, else 3 or 1) using ShortComputation_7720. Default case returns the mode unchanged. Called by UIWidgetPropagateState (0048741B).

local_names.a2: boolean state input controlling which vtable argument is used
local_names.v2: switch selector from ShortComputation_6720, also carries the function result
local_names.v3: this pointer alias (ecx) used as the vtable call receiver in cases 0-4

operations.description: Compute the widget mode by calling ShortComputation_6720(this); the result selects the switch case.
Switch on the mode 0-4 using the jump table jpt_48733E; a mode outside 0-4 falls through to the default return.
Case 0: if a2 is non-zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 2.
Case 1: if a2 is non-zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 3.
Case 2: if a2 is zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 0.
Case 3: if a2 is zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 1.

Case 4: read the current state byte via ByteFieldGetterAt100; only when it is zero, select the vtable argument (a2 != 0 ? 2 : 0 when ShortComputation_7720 is zero, otherwise 2 * (a2 != 0) + 1) and invoke the virtual method at offset 64.
Return the accumulated result v2 (mode or last vtable call result); the default case returns the mode unchanged.
